gaps.title: Legacy `inventory` page duplicates the canonical `canonical_inventory` authority
gaps.affectedRole: Warehouse operator, ops coordinator, workshop manager
gaps.businessProblem: Two primary navigation pages both present themselves as the inventory authority. A user has no way to know which reflects real stock, and each may drift from the other since they are backed by different data stores.
gaps.evidence: modules/advanced-inventory.js (renders `inventory`) uses `typeof omni !== 'undefined'` and has zero calls to platform/api/* or /api/v1/*. modules/canonical-inventory.js (renders the separate `canonical_inventory` page) is confirmed canonical, calling the platform API directly. Confirmed by direct code reading, not inference.
gaps.currentBehavior: `inventory` reads/writes an in-browser `omni` object (unclear persistence/sync story from this pass); `canonical_inventory` reads real SQLite stock data via platform/api.
gaps.desiredBusinessResult: One inventory authority, one page a warehouse operator is told to use.
gaps.uiSupport: COMPLETE but duplicated — two competing UIs for the same job
gaps.missingIntegration: None — this is a consolidation question, not an integration gap
gaps.migrationRequired: Only if retiring the legacy tables `inventory`/`advanced-inventory.js` reads from — not yet determined
gaps.preferredImplementationSurface: Retire/alias `inventory` -> `canonical_inventory` (same pattern as pos_deepening -> pos), once the owner confirms `inventory` carries no capability canonical_inventory lacks
gaps.frequency: Daily — inventory is checked constantly in a workshop
gaps.regressionRequirement: tests/page-consolidation contract test, extended, once a redirect is implemented

gaps.title: Entire `platform` namespace (notifications/activities/saved-views/chatter/search/scheduled-reports) 404'd — root-caused and fixed
gaps.businessProblem: Bigger than the my_work symptom that surfaced it: platform-runtime-bridge.mjs defines two API-mounting functions. `authority.mountApi` correctly passes notifications/jobs/scheduledReports/platformSearch/chatter/configuration -- but nothing calls it. The standalone exported `mountPlatformApi`, which server.js:2938 actually mounts at /api/v1, passed none of them, so every `resource === X && Y` branch in platform/api/index.mjs's platform-namespace block silently fell through (Y always undefined) to the generic 404 fallback.
gaps.sourcePageOrWorkflow: my_work (P0) surfaced it via saved-views; confirmed by direct curl trace that notifications and activities 404 identically
gaps.evidence: Authenticated curl against the live review server: GET /api/v1/platform/saved-views, /api/v1/platform/notifications, /api/v1/platform/activities all returned {"error":"unknown route"} 404. Traced to platform-runtime-bridge.mjs: authority.mountApi (unused, grep confirms zero call sites) vs mountPlatformApi (the one server.js calls) missing 6 fields.
gaps.currentBehavior: Fixed in code (platform-runtime-bridge.mjs mountPlatformApi now passes all 6 services); not yet re-verified live because the review server restart was queued behind an in-progress background full re-inspection to avoid killing it.
gaps.desiredBusinessResult: Notifications, activities/chatter, saved-views, search, and scheduled-reports all reachable at /api/v1/platform/*
gaps.backendSupport: COMPLETE — the services exist and are created, they just weren't passed to the HTTP mount
gaps.preferredImplementationSurface: N/A — fixed at the shared mount point, benefits every page that uses any of these 6 services, not just my_work
gaps.severity: P1 (was) — likely higher impact than P1 given it affected 6 shared services platform-wide, not just one page
gaps.frequency: Every load of any page using notifications/chatter/saved-views/search
gaps.acceptanceJourney: Code fix landed; live re-verification pending server restart
gaps.regressionRequirement: tests/functional-pages already gates the my_work symptom; consider a direct platform-namespace smoke test given the shared-mount-point nature of this bug
